schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Micro X-ray diffraction reconnaissance — the paper's first stage is "an initial, non-destructive in situ reconnaissance step using micro X-ray diffraction (mXRD) to document meteorite mineralogy and textures and to identify features of interest", valuable as "a 'no-touch' first-pass reconnaissance, which may identify areas for further study"; it then gives "point-by-point correlation of crystal structure data with other microscopic and microanalytical data" (p.2)

ada:samplingUnitName: Sample name only — "the Tagish Lake sections" (p.3), not individually labelled; the numbered points of Table 1 and Fig. 1 (e.g. "point #1", "spot 34") are μXRD spots, not SEM analyses
ada:detectionLimit: all: 0.5 wt% — 'with a detection limit of 0.5 wt% for most elements' (p.3), a capability of the Quartz XOne system
